faq: Will my site rank first on Google?
No one can promise rankings. We fix what slows your site and confuse search engines, which gives you a better base. Results depend on your market, content and time.
Do you need access to my hosting?
A WordPress administrator login is enough for most work. Some speed fixes, such as server caching, are easier with hosting access, which you can limit and remove later.
Which SEO plugin do you use?
We work with Yoast, Rank Math or All in One SEO, usually whichever you already have. We avoid running two at once and tell you if a switch would help.
Will speed changes break my pages?
We back up first and test each change, since aggressive settings can break layouts. If a setting causes trouble, we roll it back and use a safer one.
